prompt_text: Who is the best roofer in Denver for hail damage repair?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” roofer, but **CenCo Roofing** looks like a strong first call for Denver hail damage: its search listing reports a 4.9 Google rating from 843 reviews and 13+ years serving Denver. **Gates Enterprises** is another option, with a reported 4.9 rating from 353 reviews and a focus on storm and hail repairs.

Before choosing, get at least **three written estimates** and compare the inspection findings, repair scope, materials, workmanship warranty, and payment terms. Verify current insurance and local licensing, and be cautious of high-pressure sales or anyone asking for full payment upfront. Colorado’s Division of Insurance also recommends checking references, getting multiple quotes, and reading contracts carefully.

Sources: [CenCo hail-damage roofing](https://www.cencoroofing.com/residential-roofing/hail-damage/) · [Gates storm and hail repair](https://www.gatesroof.com/services/storm-hail-damage/denver) · [Colorado Division of Insurance storm guidance](https://doi.colorado.gov/news-releases-consumer-advisories/consumer-advisory-division-of-insurance-shares-tips-to-prepare)
